fieldContext.note: Some requirements are highly stable (fundamental domain rules like interest calculation in banking); others are volatile (changing tax legislation, volatile UI preferences). Identifying volatile requirements enables change-tolerant architectures.

personalNotes: Design for Change: Encapsulate volatile requirements behind interface boundaries or strategy patterns so legislative/policy changes don't ripple into core business logic.
